dedupe_keys.name: eora2 global supply chain database eora mrio

description: Eora2 is a multi-region input-output model with a time series of high-resolution input-output tables and matching environmental satellite accounts for 190 countries. The balanced global table documents purchases and sales among 19,640 sectors in 190 countries for 1990 to 2024; compared with the first Eora, it uses national input-output tables for 123 countries and improves balancing and consistency with national accounts in recent years. Raw data come from many national and international sources. Eora is offered as individual country tables (domestic IO or supply-use tables, primary inputs, final demand, imports and exports by partner, environmental accounts, in national classifications or a common 25-sector classification) and as the full MRIO with five price margins. A free licence is available for academic use at degree-granting institutions; other users obtain a licence under the terms on the licensing page. The previous Eora1 site, worldmrio.com, became read-only and stays open until 30 June 2026. Caveats: many small economies are estimated, not reported, and sector detail varies by country. For simulation it provides a very detailed global inter-industry network for supply-chain disruption, cascading economic loss and footprint analyses. Related catalogue records include EXIOBASE, the World Input-Output Database and the FIGARO tables.
